author: ballzi
body:
Its been 3 months since I have been banned and I feel strongly that this is long enough. I have had remorse for my actions and sincerely regret what I have done wrong. Like most people I was trying to fit and and be noticed. But now I am disrespected as ever. Although I have changed. I will try to be nicer and a lot more kind to others. I am sorry for the inappropriate remarks that I made in chat abusing and ruining the gameplay for others.

IGN: TimmayyyOG (recent)

Reason for ban: Sexual, racist, inappropriate remarks.


Thank you.

Regards,
